intent.title: [whatsapp-account-plugin/1] Enroll accounts and replace credentials safely
intent.responsibility: An operator can create/reopen a configured account, prove its creator chat, activate one complete private binding, inspect readiness and replace the credential for the same provider identity. Own plugin packaging/config/policy validation, protected root/store initialization, polling/binding locks, bounded read-only transport, optional local administration dispatch and setup/recovery documentation. Do not expose administrative operations in the agent catalog or implement message/media operations here.
acceptance: Real server CLI bootstrap/activation/enrollment/replacement with fake provider verifies same resolved root, wrong-chat/old-challenge rejection, blank chat, cancel/reopen, concurrent aliases and uncertain publication.

Independent processes observe complete protected bindings; missing/inconsistent state and unsafe paths fail closed. Verify Linux/macOS/Windows permission, lock and publication behavior through the declared acceptance matrix.
An existing plugin without the optional hook retains activation behavior. Explicit deny/malformed policies make no provider call.

Fake monotonic clock proves no more than 15 administrative poll starts per rolling 60 seconds, scan-to-challenge pacing continuity, same-offset 429 backoff, bounded attempt/time exhaustion, no hidden retries and unbound/unchanged failure recovery.

display.summary: Enroll accounts and replace credentials safely

intent.title: [whatsapp-account-plugin/2] Receive updates with isolated replay
intent.responsibility: Expose receive_updates through the real catalog with exact signed-64-bit cursors, validated projected envelopes, policy-based media withholding and atomic source/cursor transactions. Own normal/replay polling behavior and replay examples; reuse enrollment transport/store and locks.
acceptance: Catalog entry tests cover explicit first offset, zero, saved continuation, mismatch, replay isolation, empty/status-only batches, replaced polls, malformed envelopes and identity mismatch.
Kill a process before/after commit and drop the response; confirm transaction rollback or retained exact continuation and explicit replay recovery.
Denied ingress exposes no usable media handle, caption, digest or URL while preserving message identity.

intent.title: [whatsapp-account-plugin/3] Send text replies without duplicate submission
intent.responsibility: Expose typed text sends and source-keyed reservation/result recovery; proactive sends remain available. Own recursive nested-dataclass catalog schemas and scalar/list regressions, payload canonicalization, send lock, accepted/refused/unknown results and truthful retry guidance. Document automation source keys and ambiguity; media sends arrive in slice 6.
acceptance: Through HTTP/catalog, identical concurrent source calls cause at most one provider submission, changed payload conflicts and unknown/mismatched sources never submit.
Kill before reservation commit, after commit, during transport and before result commit; retained pending becomes unknown only under send-lock ownership and never resubmits.
Acceptance plus recording failure returns partial_failure with known result and unsafe retry guidance; nested schemas reject unknown fields while existing scalar/list operations regress cleanly.

display.summary: Send text replies without duplicate submission

intent.title: [whatsapp-account-plugin/4] Apply independent read and typing policies
intent.responsibility: Expose mark_read and typing without requiring send_messages. Enforce combined typing/read permission, return unsupported cancellation before transport, bound acknowledgements/errors and document actual provider effects.
acceptance: Exercise every typing/read permission combination through real operations, proving denied effects do not submit.
mark_read emits only read; active typing emits the combined documented request; false sends nothing and returns the selected nontransient unsupported error.

display.summary: Apply independent read and typing policies

intent.title: [whatsapp-account-plugin/5] Upload existing artifacts exactly once
intent.responsibility: Expose upload_media with a narrow same-store immutable-byte read adapter. Own exact capability URL parsing, pre-consumption type/size checks, shared root locking and consumption, bounded multipart upload and image/sticker validation. Reuse existing artifact ownership/capacity/expiry and preserve HTTP consumption behavior.
acceptance: Race HTTP open_once, plugin read and cleanup in separate processes; exactly one consumer obtains bytes and no unsafe payload path escapes.

Reject bad nonce, foreign URL/ID, expiry, policy denial, metadata oversize and unsupported MIME before consumption/provider I/O. Fault pre-claim and access-record publication; no bytes escape a failed claim.
After consumption, transport or payload-validation failure requires a fresh artifact. Probe maximum admitted bytes and image/WebP boundaries without unbounded decode.

intent.title: [whatsapp-account-plugin/6] Download, send and delete media safely
intent.responsibility: Complete typed image/audio/video/document/sticker sends plus get_media, download_media and delete_media. Own exact destination/path validation, fresh signed URLs, metadata/digest/length checks, bounded artifact publication and confirmed deletion. Apply composed effect permissions without duplicating reservation or artifact-reader mechanisms.
acceptance: Wrong host/port/userinfo/fragment/path, redirect, oversized/slow response, digest mismatch and identity/media mismatch never forward secrets or publish a valid artifact.
Metadata omits signed URLs; only provider-confirmed deletion returns deleted. Other-account/unknown/expired errors remain indistinguishable bounded failures.
All six message payload types and relevant captions/filenames are validated through the actual catalog; reactions stay receive-only.

display.summary: Download, send and delete media safely

intent.title: [whatsapp-account-plugin/7] Verify installation and publish complete operator documentation
intent.responsibility: Exercise the complete configured workflow from installed packages with deterministic provider fixtures, existing plugins and the supported platform matrix. Own final optional-package/suite integration, package-specific news, cross-slice fault/redaction tests, complete documentation/navigation and release evidence. This slice verifies integrated behavior; it is not permission to deploy or operate a live account.
acceptance: Installed package discovers all eight operations and completes enrollment -> poll -> source-keyed reply -> replay -> artifact upload/download/delete -> verified replacement without exposing secrets.

Docs follow the same installed CLI/catalog: complete setup, policy combinations/reset, readiness, recovery, unknown sends, media lifetime/consumption, local trust and migration; build the website and check links.

Run full server/plugin regression suites, platform acceptance and independent integrated security review before rollout; external live checks require their separate authorized account and disposable-data scope.

display.summary: Verify installation and publish complete operator documentation
